scope: Representative installed surface continuity after direct-manipulation migration. The exhaustive inventory establishes technical UV/PBR/mipmap qualification; these frames do not establish whole-world photorealism or human acceptance.

images.observation: Bowl, faucet and stand remain seated, with distinct porcelain, nickel and frame response.
Column glass, witness, cocks and furnace leaves retain separate visible surfaces; warm inspection illumination affects colour.
Joinery, masonry courses and canopy remain distinct; bright lintel illumination remains an aesthetic limitation.
Regular hexagonal floor grid retains consistent scale without repeated large grime patches.
Wall courses align through the corner; folded cloth and domestic door grain remain visible.
